description: Takes the contents of Terraform (.tf) files as text and lists the AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and DigitalOcean services used, how portable each is to EU-owned clouds, what replaces it, and an EU portability score. The text is scanned in memory and not stored. Remove secrets before sending.

terraform.description: Contents of one or more .tf files, joined

name: scan_terraform_lock_in
title: Scan Terraform for cloud lock-in
